denominator: all native cpu-clock samples per node, all captured Tarantool threads
user_symbols: exact captured executable and mapped DSOs, offline symfs decode

stack_presence_rules.network_write: any frame beginning sio_write, plain_iostream_write or coio_write
stack_presence_rules.gc: any frame beginning gc_ or lj_gc_, or equal to propagatemark
stack_presence_rules.allocation: any frame beginning lj_alloc_ or lj_mem_, or equal to alloc_with_limit
stack_presence_rules.crypto: any frame beginning HMAC_, EVP_, SHA256, sha256, OPENSSL_ or CRYPTO_

notes: Stack-presence counts are caller contexts; categories overlap and are not function self time.
Kernel names remain unresolved. A resolved user caller does not identify every kernel routine or establish removable work.
CPU sampling does not measure syscall latency, off-CPU waits or full-container utilization.
DWARF unwinding may stop at JIT/fiber boundaries. No JIT address maps or raw stacks are published.
